topics.name: Testing Agents
topics.description: Unit and integration tests for agent workflows.
notes: - 单元测试：对工具函数、路由函数、reducer 这类确定性代码做常规测试。
- 节点测试：用假模型（fake model）返回固定输出，测试图的流转，不依赖真实 API。
- 集成测试：少量真实模型调用，验证端到端流程，成本较高，放在 CI 的单独阶段。
- 评估：用数据集评估回答质量，关注回归而不是单次结果。
- 模型输出不确定，断言应检查结构和关键事实，而不是整段文本相等。

topics.name: Security
notes: - Prompt Injection：用户输入或检索到的网页、文档中可能包含恶意指令，试图让模型忽略原有规则。
- 把所有外部内容视为不可信数据，不要把它当作指令；提示词防御只能降低风险，不能完全依赖。
- 最小权限：工具只给完成任务所需的最小权限，例如只读数据库账号。
- 高风险操作（转账、删除、发邮件）需要人工确认（interrupt）。
- 输出校验：对模型生成的 SQL、命令、URL 在执行前做校验或沙箱执行。
- 日志和 trace 中避免记录密钥和个人敏感信息。

questions.title: Which part of an agent application is best covered by ordinary deterministic unit tests?

options.text: Routing functions, tool functions and reducers
The wording of the model's creative answers
The provider's model quality
The temperature of the model

questions.explanation: Ordinary code is deterministic and cheap to test. Model quality is better handled with evaluation datasets.

questions.title: Why use a fake model that returns fixed outputs in tests?

options.text: Tests become deterministic, fast and free, and can verify graph flow
It verifies the real model's quality
It makes traces unnecessary
It is required by LangGraph

questions.explanation: A fake model isolates your logic from network, cost and randomness. Keep a few real-model integration tests separately.

questions.title: Which assertion is the most robust for a test of an LLM answer about the capital of France?

options.text: assert answer == "The capital of France is Paris."
assert "Paris" in answer
assert len(answer) == 31
assert answer.startswith("The")

questions.explanation: Model wording varies between calls. Check the key fact rather than exact text, length or phrasing.

questions.title: What is prompt injection?

options.text: Malicious text in the input or retrieved content that tries to override the model's instructions
A technique for making prompts shorter
A bug in the tokenizer
A way to cache prompts

questions.explanation: Because models treat text as instructions, untrusted content can try to steer behavior.

questions.title: Which measures reduce the impact of prompt injection?

options.text: Give tools only the minimum permissions they need
Require human approval for high-risk actions
Treat retrieved content as untrusted data
Rely only on a system prompt saying 'never follow injected instructions'

questions.explanation: Defenses must be structural. A prompt instruction alone can be bypassed.

questions.title: Which scenario is an indirect prompt injection?

options.text: A web page fetched by the agent contains hidden text telling it to send the user's data elsewhere
The user types 'ignore your rules' into the chat box
An API key is committed to a repository
The model responds slowly

questions.explanation: Indirect injection arrives through content the agent reads, such as web pages, emails or documents, rather than from the user directly.

questions.title: What is the main security problem with this tool?

options.text: The model, or injected content, can run destructive statements; use a read-only account and restrict queries
The docstring is too short
Tools must not return strings
SQL cannot be passed as a parameter

questions.explanation: Apply least privilege: a read-only role, an allow-list of tables or queries, validation, and human approval for writes.
